title: Rigline plugin manifest
description: rigline.json: what a plugin depends on, as data. Read by the installer and by the loader without evaluating the plugin.

api.description: The version of this shape and of ctx. Only 1 exists; it moves when a meaning changes, never for growth.

name.description: Must match the plugin's directory name.

entry.description: The built entry module, relative to this file and inside this directory.

surfaces.description: The webview surfaces this plugin is for. Absent means all of them.

uses.title: uses
uses.description: Everything this plugin depends on. An identifier named here that the installed extension does not have refuses the plugin by name.

anchors.description: Curated anchor names, resolved through ctx.anchor().

classes.description: Raw module-scoped classes, by six-character module hash. The escape hatch; prefer anchors, which one table edit can repair for every plugin at once.

messages.description: Bus message types this plugin taps through ctx.onMessage().

rewrites.description: Outbound message type to the payload fields this plugin may replace. A rewrite may only name a field the message already carries.

style.description: Adds a stylesheet, which can restyle the panel.

tools.description: watches the tool calls the assistant makes, including their arguments and whether each worked

session.description: follows which session the panel is hosting

transcript.description: reads every transcript entry's identity and time, and draws on transcript rows

optional.title: uses.optional
optional.description: The same keys, for what this plugin can do without. A missing one is reported and costs the plugin that decoration; it never refuses the plugin.

anchors.description: Curated anchor names, resolved through ctx.anchor().

classes.description: Raw module-scoped classes, by six-character module hash. The escape hatch; prefer anchors, which one table edit can repair for every plugin at once.

messages.description: Bus message types this plugin taps through ctx.onMessage().

rewrites.description: Outbound message type to the payload fields this plugin may replace. A rewrite may only name a field the message already carries.

style.description: Adds a stylesheet, which can restyle the panel.

tools.description: watches the tool calls the assistant makes, including their arguments and whether each worked

session.description: follows which session the panel is hosting

transcript.description: reads every transcript entry's identity and time, and draws on transcript rows

patches.description: Byte substitutions in the extension host's own bundle, applied by the installer. A patch from a plugin outside the Rigline repository needs explicit opt-in at install.

find.description: The exact bytes to find. Must occur exactly once in the bundle.

replace.description: The bytes to write in their place. Must be the same byte length as find, because matches are located before any is written and a substitution that resized the bundle would move every offset after it.

why.description: What the patch buys. The bytes cannot say for themselves.

required.description: Refuse the plugin when the patch cannot apply, rather than loading it without. Default false.
